title: bug: VS Code prior-handoff card reads from/to/createdAt, but the daemon writes releasedBy/releasedAt/reason, so every card title is just "#N" (VS Code twin of the DONE JetBrains fix ac587df5)
definitionOfDone: VS Code's HandoffNote type and renderHandoff use releasedBy, releasedAt and reason. The card title matches the JetBrains header (d5f36e82): "#N released by X (time): reason", each part only when present and HTML-escaped. A note without them still renders "#N".

The task-time-budget fixture uses the daemon's handoff shape, and a test fails if the title reads from/to/createdAt again. moe-vscode `npm test` and `npm run compile` pass. No file outside moe-vscode/ changes.
